title: Book Golden Life Cottage | Cottage Rental in Rosemary Beach | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Golden Life Cottage is a spacious 3-bed, 3-bath cottage rental in Rosemary Beach with room for 8 guests. Read on to learn about this lovely rental property and book a stay!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

The first thing you will notice about the Golden Life Cottage is the charming exterior. As you explore the grounds, you’ll be delighted to discover the outside cooking area complete with sitting areas and a grill perfect for a late-night cookout followed by dinner under the stars. When you walk inside, you’ll first spot the lovely kitchen area that hosts granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. As you walk in further, you’ll spy a dining area that seats six, while the breakfast bar allows for three more to join. The living area hosts a selection of comfy and welcoming couches and armchairs, all centered around a beautiful blue fireplace that is sure to add the perfect ambiance to those late-night chats. Further, just above this, you’ll find the flat-screen television which lets you enjoy your favorite TV shows or movies.

As you continue to explore, you’ll spot the staircase leading up to the second floor. The master bedroom hosts a king bed with a private, shuttered balcony. You’ll also find a private bath complete with a beautiful, blue-tiled walk-in shower. In addition, a small sitting area makes this the perfect place for that family member who likes a bit of time to themselves. If you continue to adventure, you’ll find the second bedroom nearby, which offers a queen-sized bed and flat screen tv. You’ll also find the final bedroom which is perfect for any little ones who wanted to come along, as it hosts a set of built in twin beds above a full size bed. The guest bedrooms share the nearby hall bathroom.

Parking for two in gravel lot.
If you’d like to find out more about this rental or are curious about what else we just might have to offer, make sure you inquire further by contacting Rosemary Beach at (866) 348-8952 or book your stay online today!

THS PROPERTY REQUIRES A 7-NIGHT STAY FROM SATURDAY-SATURDAY DURING PEAK SEASONS (SUMMER AND SPRING BREAK)
